Camera models in JPL's CAHV, CAHVOR and CAHVORE forms.

- `m2020_camera_models.json`: six of the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover's and Ingenuity helicopter's camera models (HAZFLA, NAVL, NAVR, MCAM_Z_LEFT-Z026, SuperCam, HELI_NAVCAM), taken unchanged from NASA-JPL's m2020-urdf-models (`m2020-camera-models.json`, https://github.com/nasa-jpl/m2020-urdf-models, released 10 June 2022 as URS307049 and URS309682). Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech.
